subject: RP11 data spec: 1 W2.d question needed to hit coverage threshold
body:
GR — full RP11 spec is in docs/gi-rp11-data-spec.md. Summary:

W2.d at 4/5 threshold. Need 1 more question in RP11.

Suggested Q14:
  f(x) = 2(x-3)^2 - 8
  (a) vertex: (3, -8)
  (b) axis of symmetry: x=3
  (c) roots: x=5 or x=1

All answer values (3, -8, 5, 1) are free in W2.d slot space.
Type: write-equation (not multiple-choice — RP7 already used that).

See spec doc for full schema checklist and uniqueness constraints.

— GI
